mapper.select: SELECT OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AS orderItemNo, OI.ORDER_NO AS orderNo, OI.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, OI.BUSINESS_NO AS businessNo, OI.PRODUCT_PRICE AS productPrice, OI.QUANTITY AS quantity, OI.STATUS AS status, NVL(D.STATUS, 'CONFIRMED') AS deliveryStatus FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_NO = OI.ORDER_NO LEFT JOIN DELIVERY D ON D.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO WHERE O.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND O.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} AND ( (OI.STATUS = 'PAID' AND NVL(D.STATUS, 'CONFIRMED') = 'CONFIRMED') OR (OI.STATUS = 'DELIVERED' AND NVL(D.STATUS, 'DELIVERED') = 'DELIVERED' AND NVL(D.DELIVERED_AT, D.UPDATED_AT) IS NOT NULL AND SYSDATE <= NVL(D.DELIVERED_AT, D.UPDATED_AT) + 7) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDER_ITEM X LEFT JOIN DELIVERY XD ON XD.ORDER_ITEM_NO = X.ORDER_ITEM_NO WHERE X.ORDER_NO = OI.ORDER_NO AND X.STATUS NOT IN ('CANCELED', 'REFUNDED') AND NOT ( (X.STATUS = OI.STATUS AND OI.STATUS = 'PAID' AND NVL(XD.STATUS, 'CONFIRMED') = 'CONFIRMED') OR (X.STATUS = OI.STATUS AND OI.STATUS = 'DELIVERED' AND NVL(XD.STATUS, 'DELIVERED') = 'DELIVERED' AND NVL(XD.DELIVERED_AT, XD.UPDATED_AT) IS NOT NULL AND SYSDATE <= NVL(XD.DELIVERED_AT, XD.UPDATED_AT) + 7) ) ) ORDER BY OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO

SELECT OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AS orderItemNo, OI.ORDER_NO AS orderNo, OI.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, OI.BUSINESS_NO AS businessNo, OI.PRODUCT_PRICE AS productPrice, OI.QUANTITY AS quantity, OI.STATUS AS status, NVL(D.STATUS, 'CONFIRMED') AS deliveryStatus FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_NO = OI.ORDER_NO LEFT JOIN DELIVERY D ON D.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO WHERE O.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo} AND ( (OI.STATUS = 'PAID' AND NVL(D.STATUS, 'CONFIRMED') = 'CONFIRMED') OR (OI.STATUS = 'DELIVERED' AND NVL(D.STATUS, 'DELIVERED') = 'DELIVERED' AND NVL(D.DELIVERED_AT, D.UPDATED_AT) IS NOT NULL AND SYSDATE <= NVL(D.DELIVERED_AT, D.UPDATED_AT) + 7) )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CANCEL_REQUEST WHERE ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo} AND STATUS = 'WAITING'

SELECT SEQ_CANCEL_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CANCEL_REQUEST ( CANCEL_NO, ORDER_NO, ORDER_ITEM_NO, MEMBER_NO, CANCEL_TYPE, CANCEL_GROUP_NO, REFUND_AMOUNT, REASON, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{cancelNo}, #{orderNo}, #{orderItemNo}, #{memberNo}, #{cancelType}, #{cancelGroupNo}, #{refundAmount}, #{reason}, 'WAITING', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDER_ITEM SET STATUS = 'CANCEL_REQUEST' WHERE ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo} AND STATUS IN ('PAID', 'DELIVERED')
mapper.select:
SELECT MIN(CR.CANCEL_NO) AS CANCEL_NO, MIN(CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO) AS ORDER_ITEM_NO, CR.ORDER_NO, MIN(CR.MEMBER_NO) AS MEMBER_NO, OI.BUSINESS_NO, MIN(OI.PRODUCT_NO) AS PRODUCT_NO, CASE WHEN CR.CANCEL_TYPE = 'FULL' THEN LISTAGG(P.PRODUCT_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CR.CANCEL_NO) ELSE MIN(P.PRODUCT_NAME) END AS PRODUCT_NAME, MIN(OI.PRODUCT_PRICE) AS PRODUCT_PRICE, SUM(OI.QUANTITY) AS QUANTITY, SUM(CR.REFUND_AMOUNT) AS CANCEL_AMOUNT, MIN(CR.REASON) AS REASON, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CR.STATUS = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CR.STATUS = 'WAITING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'WAITING' ELSE 'APPROVED' END AS STATUS, MIN(CR.CREATED_AT) AS CREATED_AT, MAX(CR.PROCESSED_AT) AS PROCESSED_AT, MAX(CR.REJECT_REASON) AS REJECT_REASON, CR.CANCEL_TYPE, CR.CANCEL_GROUP_NO, SUM(CR.REFUND_AMOUNT) AS REFUND_AMOUNT, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = OI.PRODUCT_NO WHERE OI.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} GROUP BY CR.ORDER_NO, OI.BUSINESS_NO, CR.CANCEL_TYPE, CR.CANCEL_GROUP_NO
HAVING CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CR.STATUS = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CR.STATUS = 'WAITING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'WAITING' ELSE 'APPROVED' END = #{status}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN CR.STATUS = 'WAITING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, MIN(CR.CREATED_AT) DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

SELECT CR.CANCEL_NO, CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO, CR.ORDER_NO, CR.MEMBER_NO, OI.BUSINESS_NO, OI.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, OI.PRODUCT_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY, CR.REFUND_AMOUNT AS CANCEL_AMOUNT, CR.REASON, CR.STATUS, CR.CREATED_AT, CR.PROCESSED_AT, CR.REJECT_REASON, CR.CANCEL_TYPE, CR.CANCEL_GROUP_NO, CR.REFUND_AMOUNT, 1 AS ITEM_COUNT FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = OI.PRODUCT_NO WHERE CR.CANCEL_NO = #{cancelNo} AND OI.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE CANCEL_REQUEST SET STATUS = 'APPROVED', PROCESSED_AT = SYSDATE, REJECT_REASON = NULL WHERE CANCEL_NO = #{cancelNo} AND STATUS = 'WAITING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CANCEL_REQUEST WHERE CANCEL_GROUP_NO = #{cancelGroupNo} AND STATUS = 'WAITING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CANCEL_REQUEST WHERE CANCEL_GROUP_NO = #{cancelGroupNo} AND STATUS = 'REJECTED'

SELECT CR.CANCEL_NO, CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO, CR.ORDER_NO, CR.MEMBER_NO, OI.BUSINESS_NO, OI.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, OI.PRODUCT_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY, CR.REFUND_AMOUNT AS CANCEL_AMOUNT, CR.REASON, CR.STATUS, CR.CREATED_AT, CR.PROCESSED_AT, CR.REJECT_REASON, CR.CANCEL_TYPE, CR.CANCEL_GROUP_NO, CR.REFUND_AMOUNT, 1 AS ITEM_COUNT FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = OI.PRODUCT_NO WHERE CR.CANCEL_GROUP_NO = #{cancelGroupNo} ORDER BY CR.CANCEL_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDER_ITEM OI SET OI.STATUS = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DELIVERY D WHERE D.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND D.STATUS = 'DELIVERED') THEN 'DELIVERED' ELSE 'PAID' END WHERE OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo} AND OI.STATUS = 'CANCEL_REQUEST'

UPDATE ORDER_ITEM OI SET OI.STATUS = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DELIVERY D WHERE D.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND D.STATUS = 'DELIVERED') THEN 'DELIVERED' ELSE 'PAID' END WHERE OI.STATUS = 'CANCEL_REQUEST' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR WHERE CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND CR.CANCEL_GROUP_NO = #{cancelGroupNo} )
UPDATE ORDER_ITEM SET STATUS = 'CANCELED' WHERE ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo} AND STATUS = 'CANCEL_REQUEST'

UPDATE ORDER_ITEM OI SET OI.STATUS = 'CANCELED' WHERE OI.STATUS = 'CANCEL_REQUEST' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR WHERE CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND CR.CANCEL_GROUP_NO = #{cancelGroupNo} )

UPDATE SETTLEMENT_REQUEST SR SET SR.STATUS = 'REJECTED', SR.PROCESSED_AT = SYSDATE, SR.REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason} WHERE SR.STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'DONE') AND SR.REQUEST_NO = ( SELECT S.REQUEST_NO FROM SETTLEMENT S WHERE S.ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo} AND S.REQUEST_NO IS NOT NULL )

UPDATE SETTLEMENT S SET S.REQUEST_NO = NULL, S.STATUS = 'WAITING', S.SETTLED_AT = NULL WHERE S.ORDER_ITEM_NO != #{orderItemNo} AND S.STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'DONE') AND S.REQUEST_NO = ( SELECT TARGET.REQUEST_NO FROM SETTLEMENT TARGET WHERE TARGET.ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo} AND TARGET.REQUEST_NO IS NOT NULL )
UPDATE SETTLEMENT SET STATUS = 'REJECTED', SETTLED_AT = NULL WHERE ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo} AND STATUS IN ('WAITING', 'REQUESTED', 'DONE')

UPDATE SETTLEMENT_REQUEST SR SET SR.STATUS = 'REJECTED', SR.PROCESSED_AT = SYSDATE, SR.REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason} WHERE SR.STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'DONE') AND SR.REQUEST_NO IN ( SELECT DISTINCT S.REQUEST_NO FROM SETTLEMENT S JOIN CANCEL_REQUEST CR ON CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO = S.ORDER_ITEM_NO WHERE CR.CANCEL_GROUP_NO = #{cancelGroupNo} AND S.REQUEST_NO IS NOT NULL )

UPDATE SETTLEMENT S SET S.REQUEST_NO = NULL, S.STATUS = 'WAITING', S.SETTLED_AT = NULL WHERE S.STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'DONE') AND S.REQUEST_NO IN ( SELECT DISTINCT TARGET.REQUEST_NO FROM SETTLEMENT TARGET JOIN CANCEL_REQUEST CR_TARGET ON CR_TARGET.ORDER_ITEM_NO = TARGET.ORDER_ITEM_NO WHERE CR_TARGET.CANCEL_GROUP_NO = #{cancelGroupNo} AND TARGET.REQUEST_NO IS NOT NULL ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR WHERE CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO = S.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND CR.CANCEL_GROUP_NO = #{cancelGroupNo} )

UPDATE SETTLEMENT S SET S.STATUS = 'REJECTED', S.SETTLED_AT = NULL WHERE S.STATUS IN ('WAITING', 'REQUESTED', 'DONE') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR WHERE CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO = S.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND CR.CANCEL_GROUP_NO = #{cancelGroupNo} )
UPDATE PRODUCT SET STOCK = STOCK + #{quantity} WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo}

MERGE INTO PRODUCT_OPTION PO
USING ( SELECT OI.OPTION_NO, OI.QUANTITY FROM ORDER_ITEM OI WHERE OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo} AND OI.OPTION_NO IS NOT NULL ) RESTORE_ITEM
ON ( PO.OPTION_NO = RESTORE_ITEM.OPTION_NO )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET PO.STOCK = PO.STOCK + RESTORE_ITEM.QUANTITY

UPDATE ORDERS O SET O.ORDER_STATUS = ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS = 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'CANCELED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS = 'CANCEL_REQUEST' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'CANCEL_REQUEST' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS = 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'PARTIAL_CANCELED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS = 'SHIPPING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'SHIPPING' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS = 'PREPARING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'PREPARING' ELSE 'PAID' END FROM ORDER_ITEM OI WHERE OI.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} ) WHERE O.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}
